responsibility: Defines the lightweight region-allocation utilities shared by BIR construction and fact collection. It introduces FreeRegion and the FreeRegions container for lists of bound Polonius origins, plus RegionBinder for turning Rust type-level regions into concrete per-function free-region identifiers by reusing early-bound lifetimes, mapping 'static to origin 0, and allocating fresh anonymous regions, making this file the common bridge between Rust lifetime syntax/type information and borrow-checker region IDs.
